title_en: A new record for automobile exports in July... Electric vehicles and hybrids lead the way
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Last month, automobile exports increased by 7% compared to the same month last year, reaching $6.24 billion, recording the highest July export performance ever. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced this through the automobile industry trends for July on the 13th. Domestic sales last month were 139,000 units and production was 352,000 units, respectively 0.5% and 11.3% compared to the same period last year. Exports showed a strong trend, centering on eco-friendly cars. Eco-friendly vehicle exports amounted to $2.59 billion, a 25.5% increase compared to the same month last year. Among these, electric and hydrogen vehicles increased by 31.9% to $940 million, and hybrid vehicles increased by 22.2% to $1.65 billion, while internal combustion engine vehicles decreased by 3.1% to $3.65 billion. By region, exports increased mainly in North America and the European Union (EU), which are the main markets. Exports to North America increased 18% compared to the same month last year to $3.25 billion, and to the EU increased 23.5% to $880 million. It is analyzed that the increase in exports was supported by the increase in working days due to the shift in the timing of summer vacations of major automakers and the solid global demand for eco-friendly cars and SUV models. In particular, exports to the Middle East increased by 12.7% compared to the same month last year...

title_en: When will 13-year-old Kyobo Life Planet escape from the deficit swamp?
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Kyobo Life Planet, the first digital life insurance company established in 2013, is still unable to escape the swamp of deficit. As people have become accustomed to purchasing insurance through PCs and mobile devices compared to the past, attention is being paid to whether they can succeed in a turnaround or be integrated into Kyobo Life Insurance. Kyobo Life Planet has never achieved an annual surplus since its establishment in 2013. The deficit, which was 5 billion won in the first year of establishment, expanded to 21.4 billion won in 2023 when the new international accounting standard (IFRS17) was introduced, and a loss of close to 20 billion won is estimated in 2025 as well. Kyobo Life Planet's accumulated deficit over 13 years amounts to approximately 220 billion won. Although the company is in deficit, it is meeting the soundness indicators recommended by the financial supervisory authority in order to avoid returning its life insurance company license. To this end, Kyobo Life Insurance, the parent company, continued to increase paid-in capital several times. The total amount invested by Kyobo Life Insurance into Kyobo Life Planet, including the initial capital of establishment, is estimated to be 330 billion won. title_en: NHN Cloud improves public system stability... ‘Tibero TAC’ cloud verification
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea]NHN Cloud is taking the lead in strengthening the stability and flexibility of public important information systems by applying high-availability database (DB) technology to the cloud environment. NHN Cloud announced on the 13th that it has cooperated with Tmax Tibero to verify the stable operation possibility of 'Tibero Active Cluster (TAC)' in a multi-hypervisor-based cloud environment and applied it to the Daegu Public-Private Partnership Cloud (PPP). Tibero TAC supports multiple DB servers at the same time. It is a high availability solution based on active-active clustering. Since multiple servers process tasks simultaneously, even if one server fails, another server can take over the service and minimize service interruption. According to the company, the key to implementing such high availability of TAC in a cloud environment is a redundant configuration that distributes virtual machines on different hypervisor nodes. Even if a specific hypervisor fails, virtual machines running on other hypervisors can maintain services. title_ja: サムスンSDS、政府AI行政先頭に立つ… 「ブリティワークス」中央省庁9ヶ所導入
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]サムスンSDSが人工知能（AI）コラボレーションソリューション「ブリティッシュワークス」を中央省庁中心に公共部門に拡散している。行政安全部の生成型AI基盤業務イノベーション政策と連携して公共部門AI転換（AX）を加速するという戦略だ。国家保訓部・産業通商部・雇用労働部・金融委員会・在外同胞庁などだ。当省は来月順次サービスを開始する予定だ。 先に行安部は今年下半期までに生成型AIベースのインテリジェント業務管理プラットフォーム「オンAI」を40以上の中央行政機関に拡大する計画を発表した。サムスンSDSはブリティッシュワークスをオンAIの公式コラボレーションツールとして提供し、政府AI行政革新を支援中だ。生成型AIを業務過程に自然に組み合わせて、公務員の業務効率性を高め、省庁間のコラボレーションを強化することに重点を置いた。特にモバイルベースのコラボレーション機能を強化したのが特徴だ。
title_en: Samsung SDS takes the lead in government AI administration... ‘Britty Works’ introduced in 9 central ministries
summary_en: [GDNet Korea] Samsung SDS is spreading its artificial intelligence (AI) collaboration solution ‘Brityworks’ to the public sector, focusing on central ministries. The strategy is to accelerate public sector AI transformation (AX) in connection with the Ministry of Public Administration and Security's generative AI-based work innovation policy. Samsung SDS announced on the 13th that its AI collaboration solution Brityworks will be adopted as an official collaboration tool for government ministries and will be introduced to a total of 9 central ministries. summary_source: 테슬라가 미국 텍사스에 100억달러(약 14조1500억원) 규모의 태양광 제조공장 건설을 검토하고 있다. 텍사스가 최종 후보지로 선정되면 2026년 착공해 2028년 공사를 마치고 2029년 1분기 상업생산에 들어갈 계획이다.테슬라는 지난달 22일(현지시간) 텍사스주 회계감사관실에 제출된 일자리·에너지·기술·혁신법(JETI) 세제지원 신청서를 통해 포트벤드 카운티 라마 통합교육구 일대에서 '프로젝트 크리스털 선(Project Crystal Sun)'이라는 태양광 제조시설 건설을 검토 중이라고 밝혔다.연도별 투자액은 2026년 23억
title_ja: テスラ、テキサスに14兆規模の太陽光製造工場を検討… 2029年の稼働目標
summary_ja: テスラが米国テキサスに１００億ドル（約１４兆１５００億ウォン）規模の太陽光製造工場建設を検討している。テキサスが最終候補地に選定されると、2026年に着工し、2028年に工事を終え、2029年第1四半期の商業生産に入る計画だ。ラマ統合教育区一帯で「プロジェクトクリスタルサン（Project Crystal Sun）」という太陽光製造施設の建設を検討中だと明らかにした。

summary_en: Tesla is considering building a $10 billion (approximately KRW 14.15 trillion) solar manufacturing plant in Texas, USA. If Texas is selected as the final candidate site, construction is scheduled to begin in 2026, complete construction in 2028, and begin commercial production in the first quarter of 2029. Tesla plans to build a solar power manufacturing facility called 'Project Crystal Sun' in the Lamar Unified School District in Fort Bend County through a Jobs, Energy, Technology, and Innovation Act (JETI) tax support application submitted to the Texas State Comptroller's Office on the 22nd of last month (local time). It was announced that it is under review. The annual investment amount is 2.3 billion won in 2026.

summary_source: 낮에 집중되던 태양광 발전이 배터리 저장장치 확대로 저녁 전력시장까지 공급 시간을 넓히고 있다. 올해 전 세계에서 새로 설치되는 배터리 저장용량은 459기가와트시(GWh)에 이를 전망이라는 분석이 나왔다. 캘리포니아에서는 태양광과 배터리가 이미 저녁 시간대 전력수요의 4분의 1 이상을 공급하고 있다.에너지 싱크탱크 엠버가 12일(현지시간) 공개한 분석에 따르면 태양광은 올해 상반기 세계 전력생산의 10%를 차지했다.2023년 상반기 5.6%에서 3년 만에 비중이 약 두 배로 높아졌다. 평균적으로 정오에는 세계 전력수요의 25% 이상
title_ja: 世界電力10％太陽光時代…バッテリーが夜の電力市場を広げる
summary_ja: 日中に集中していた太陽光発電がバッテリー貯蔵装置の拡大で、夕方の電力市場まで供給時間を広げている。今年、全世界で新たに設置されるバッテリー貯蔵容量は４５９ギガワット時（ＧＷｈ）に達する見通しという分析が出た。カリフォルニアでは、太陽光とバッテリーはすでに夕方の時間帯電力需要の4分の1以上を供給している。平均して、正午には世界の電力需要の25％以上
title_en: An era where 10% of the world's electricity comes from solar energy... Batteries expand the evening power market
summary_en: Solar power generation, which was concentrated during the day, is expanding its supply time to the evening power market due to the expansion of battery storage devices. Analysis has shown that new battery storage capacity installed around the world this year is expected to reach 459 gigawatt hours (GWh). In California, solar power and batteries already supply more than a quarter of electricity demand during evening hours. According to an analysis released by energy think tank Ember on the 12th (local time), solar power accounted for 10% of global electricity production in the first half of this year. The share has approximately doubled in three years from 5.6% in the first half of 2023. On average, more than 25% of global electricity demand occurs at noon.

summary_en: The government is promoting the commercialization of perovskite tandem solar cells with the goal of achieving a power generation efficiency of over 35%. It is also working to develop solar energy technology to be applied to space data centers. The Ministry of Science and ICT, along with related ministries, announced a strategy to foster cutting-edge technologies at the ‘7 SEED Future Growth Engines Briefing Session’ held at the Blue House on the 12th. In the field of renewable energy, high-efficiency solar power. Technology was included as a key task. The government plans to achieve an efficiency of over 35% Perovse.
